thread:
Alana: Quick heads-up — planning to onboard slatex-v3-lite into model-catalog tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:00 PST. Targeting a small canary (5%) then scale. Need: pin slot, someone to run smoke, rollback owner, and quick CR approval for catalog entry. cc @sasha @jit

Mike: I can do the catalog CR review now. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/catalog/changes/123

Jit: I'll run the smoke window and watch latency/traces. Can we make the canary window 15m?

Alana: Yes. Plan: canary 5% for 15m, smoke checks at +2m and +10m, then bump if stable. Rollback policy: immediate rollback to slatex-v2 if >3% error or 20% latency regression.

Sasha: I'll be on-call for rollback. If I don't ack within 5m, page me. Also ensure the model is pinned so traffic doesn't drift.

Nina: What's the exact pin config? Need the catalog diff.

Alana: model catalog diff:
```yaml
model:
  id: redwood/slatex
  version: v3-lite
  pinned_at: 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z
  canary:
    percent: 5
    duration: 15m
  fallback: redwood/slatex@v2
resources:
  quant: int8
  cpu: 2
  gpu: t4-small
```

Mike: CR LGTM, left a small nit re: gpu label.

deploy-bot: Deployment reserved: slot-id=slot-8732 reserved for 2026-03-18T09:00Z by @alana

Alana: I'll kick it at 09:00 PST. Ping here when starting.

Jit: I'll join at 09:02 PST for smoke. Tools I'll run: curl test, small eval set, and tail logs:
```bash
# smoke commands
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/run -d '{"model":"redwood/slatex","input":"short test"}'
kubectl logs -f deploy/slatex-v3-lite -n models | grep ERROR
```

Sasha: Suggested rollback steps:
- set catalog pin to v2
- trigger variant-swap on routing
- scale down new pods
- monitor for error drop

Nina: Confirmed we have eval set and golden prompts. I'll trigger synthetic eval at +3m.

Mike: tagging infra to keep an eye on GPU saturation: @infra-team

Alana: thanks all. After canary I'll post final signal here. :thumbsup: 

Sasha: :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-18T09:00:12Z, percent=5

Jit: smoke @ 09:02 — passing initial latency & tokens/sec look stable.

Nina: synthetic eval +3m — 0.5% output quality regressions (within threshold)

Mike: infra reported GPU temp normal, no queuing.

Alana: bump to 50% at 09:20 PST per plan.

deploy-bot: Traffic bumped to 50% at 2026-03-18T09:20:05Z

Sasha: I'll hold off rollback. monitoring 15m window.

Mike: final checks look good. Marking as onboarded when stable for 30m.

Alana: locking catalog pin to v3-lite at 09:50 PST.

deploy-bot: Pin updated: redwood/slatex@v3-lite locked at 2026-03-18T09:50:30Z by @alana

Alana: Thanks everyone. Filing post-deploy notes in the runbook.

End."
